## Location

File, claim, and section or command.

## Problem

Give a derivation, counterexample, missing hypothesis, or reproducible failure.

## Consequence

Does this invalidate a proof step, a specified route, or the statement itself?

## Proposed correction

Provide the smallest supported correction and identify affected downstream claims.
